failures.evidence: Main sends a mention under the key <comment>:<target>:<mode> (main's comment_delivery.go: stored.ID+":"+target.Target+":"+target.Delivery). This PR sends it under <comment>:<target> (model.CommentMentionIdempotencyKey, model.go:1294, used at comment_delivery.go:653 and outbox/mentions.go:403). The listener uses the idempotency key as the dedupe key, so a send by this build of a mention the previous build already delivered is a different event for 72 h after the deploy: a sweep resend of a stranded attempt, a same-mode Retry of an old receipt timeout, and the outbox copy of an old failed attempt. The reviewer's deep reviewer reproduced the first two on the test listener with repeat-dropping on. The fix is the implementer's: key by the mention's own mode, <comment>:<target>:<comment_mentions.delivery>, with a test that sends under main's key and resends from this build. I did not commit a red test for it this round: my attempts to write the test file did not go through, and nothing is on legion/INFRA-606-wip.
